name: Turntech
old_description: Founded in April of 2002 by Curvin & Lucille Horning, Turntech started in a 2-car garage with one hydraulic copy lathe and a dream. Not to mention a mini fridge stocked with Mountain Dew and peanut butter cups!
about:
Turntech is based in Ephrata, Pennsylvania, and was founded in April 2002 by Curvin and Lucille Horning. The company began in a two-car garage with a single hydraulic copy lathe and a modest vision for custom wood turning.

Today, Turntech produces a wide range of custom wood products including columns, porch posts, mouldings, kitchen island legs, wooden balls, and dowels. The shop operates multiple CNC machines, highlighted by a custom CNC lathe capable of turning pieces up to 17½ inches in diameter and 144 inches long. Processes include reeding, rope twisting, barley twisting, and fluting, applied to wood species such as walnut, cherry, mahogany, maple, oak, cedar, pine, and poplar. The facility has expanded from its garage origins to a dedicated location in Lancaster County, though headcount and annual volume are not disclosed.

The company serves contractors restoring historic properties, homeowners updating staircases and entryways, furniture makers, stairway manufacturers, arts-and-crafts enthusiasts, and even martial-arts practitioners who use Turntech's wooden balls for training. Customers can submit photos, sketches, or CAD drawings for exact replication of existing designs.

Turntech emphasizes domestic production, made-to-order flexibility, and a typical turnaround of as little as five business days. The founders' original commitment to combining old-world craftsmanship with modern technology remains central, and the business stresses employment of local craftsmen and community involvement in Lancaster County.

name: U.S. Packaging & Wrapping LLC.
old_description: At US Packaging and Wrapping, we understand that effective packaging is crucial to your operation's success. Since our founding, we've been dedicated to providing high-quality industrial packaging materials and equipment that protect your products and streamline your processes. Whether you're a small business or a large manufacturing facility, our extensive selection ensures you'll find exactly what you need.
about:
U.S. Packaging & Wrapping LLC is based in Austin, Arkansas. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it has established itself as a supplier of industrial packaging materials and equipment for businesses ranging from small operations to large manufacturing facilities.

The firm stocks a broad line of packaging consumables — including PVC and polyolefin shrink films, biodegradable POF films, polyethylene tubing, stretch films (hand, machine, pre‑stretch, opaque, and colored), conductive and static‑shielding bags, and barrier shrink bags. It also sells packaging machinery such as automatic shrink bundlers, L‑bar sealers, side‑sealing shrink wrappers, shrink tunnels, I‑bar sealers, vacuum sealers, stretch wrap machines, case sealers, and strapping equipment. Beyond product sales, the company offers contract packaging services, equipment parts and repair, an interactive demo room for equipment evaluation, and a product‑testing service for customers.

Its customer base spans food packaging (pizza films, barrier bags), electronics (static‑sensitive and flammable‑product shielding), general industrial manufacturing, and shipping/logistics operations. The company highlights its ability to serve both small businesses and high‑volume plants with the same product range.

The company positions itself on decades of packaging experience, honest recommendations, competitive pricing, and a consultative approach that aims to help customers “buy right the first time.” It also promotes unmatched service, industry‑machinery, and flexible Net 30 payment terms as key differentiators.

name: USA Injection Molding
old_description: USA Injection’s parent company, LMT Mercer Group, Inc., was formed in 1987 to supply the fence and deck industry with high-quality component parts. Today, we are the largest manufacturer of fence, deck and railing accessories to the US and Canada with more than 950 products.  Additionally, we now serve all industries that use plastic injection molding products and components.  We manufacture a broad range of products designed to meet the needs of a diverse and demanding customer base, introducing at least twenty (20) new products each year.
about:
USA Injection Molding, a division of LMT Mercer Group, Inc., is headquartered in Lawrenceville, New Jersey. The parent company was formed in 1987 to supply the fence and deck industry with high-quality component parts.

The company operates as a full-service custom plastic injection molding facility with manufacturing plants in New Jersey and Ohio, plus distribution centers in New Jersey, Ohio, and Nevada. It runs 36 injection molding machines ranging from 60 to 1,000 tons, equipped with servo-robotics and nitrogen gas-assist capabilities. In-house tooling builds close to 100 new molds per year, from single-cavity prototypes to 64-cavity high-production molds. The facility stocks over 50 certified resins and operates a material testing laboratory. USA Injection Molding produces more than 950 fence, deck, and railing accessories and introduces at least 20 new products annually.

The company serves a broad range of industries including medical, military and defense, personal care, building and construction, housewares and consumer products, cosmetics, agricultural and farming, vinyl fence and railing, appliances, automotive, commercial food packaging, electronics, office products, and wood composite decking and railing. It also supports any industry requiring plastic injection molded components.

USA Injection Molding emphasizes domestic manufacturing, in-house engineering and tooling, rapid prototyping printed in hours, and distribution from three U.S. warehouses. Its stated mission is to be the industry leader in design, manufacturing, and distribution of plastic injection molding products by setting benchmarks for quality, customer service, and competitive pricing.

The firm distributes a broad range of industrial cable products — including instrumentation, thermocouple, control, tray, portable power, medium voltage, armored, single conductor, and substation cable — sourced from American manufacturers. name: Ullmer's Dairy Equipment & Fabrication
old_description: Whether you’re looking to buy or sell dairy equipment, need a refurbish, or require custom fabrication, Ullmer’s Dairy Equipment & Fabrication is your trusted partner. Our dedication to quality and personalized service makes us the premier choice for all your dairy equipment needs.
about:
Ullmer's Dairy Equipment & Fabrication operates from Pulaski, Wisconsin. The company was founded in 1991 by Francis Ullmer, who began by selling a single bulk tank from his front yard. The business grew into a 10-acre inventory of used cheese-making equipment in Northeast Wisconsin.

Today the company runs a well-equipped production shop with an in-house engineering team and skilled fabricators. They specialize in custom fabrication of food-grade stainless steel equipment, including batch pasteurizers, butter churns, cheese cutters, presses, vats, CIP systems, combo vats, conveyors, COP tanks, curd mills, curd unloaders, drain tables, hoop washers, and stainless steel tanks. The shop also refurbishes used dairy equipment and buys, sells, and trades inventory. No headcount or facility square footage is disclosed.

Ullmer's serves the cheese, dairy, food, beverage, and other sanitary industries. Their customer base includes cheese makers, wineries, breweries, maple syrup producers, honey makers, and educational institutions. They provide both custom-built equipment and refurbished units for these sectors.

The company emphasizes honesty, integrity, and exceptional customer satisfaction, aiming to exceed expectations with precision and care. Their stated differentiators include competitive pricing, dependable experienced staff, and a commitment to versatility—captured in their motto that there's nothing they can't do when they set their minds to it.

name: Unbound Solar
old_description: Unbound Solar is a distributor of solar equipment. Offers a wide range of solar panels and complete solar kits for residential and commercial installations.
about:
Unbound Solar was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Fullerton, California. The company operates as a distributor of solar equipment, providing panels, inverters, and complete system kits for residential and commercial installations.

The firm supplies professional-grade solar components and pairs them with design, permitting, and lifetime support services aimed at self-installers. Its offerings include grid-tie, off-grid, and commercial system packages, backed by engineering expertise and a reported 97% permit approval rate across more than 20,000 installed systems. The team of 10–49 employees manages product selection, system design, and customer guidance.

Unbound Solar serves homeowners, builders, and professional installers through its Builders & Installer Program. Residential customers use the company’s design tools and permitting assistance to install systems themselves, while commercial clients access custom engineering and volume pricing. The company also provides online calculators for cost, battery sizing, and production estimates.

The company emphasizes its 20-plus years of experience in self-install solar, highlighting expert engineering, professional-grade equipment, and ongoing lifetime support as key differentiators. It also offers free permitting and interconnection help to reduce project friction.
